title: Hear How the CEO of AllMark Health Views the Athelas Suite
summary: Hear the CEO of AllMark Health discuss the Athelas suite.
body_markdown:
Mark Greenwell, founder and CEO of AllMark Health, has emerged as one of the most vocal advocates for the Athelas product suite. Known for his deep expertise in healthcare operations and technology, Greenwell praised Athelas for delivering a comprehensive, AI-powered platform built specifically for the complex needs of medical practices.


“I looked into a variety of companies that were delivering AI solutions, and I became convinced that your solution was one of the best, if not the best,” he said. “You have a suite of products and solutions developed specifically for healthcare, powered by AI—and it’s denial management, data management, practice management, payor management, cash management, and contractuals management. I think you're the only one offering the full suite of services.”


Greenwell emphasized that Athelas is more than just a vendor—it’s a strategic partner that helps AllMark drive measurable improvements in revenue performance and operational efficiency.
